name: SMA Trend Filter (Faber)
description: Binary 10-month (approx 200 trading day) simple moving average crossover: hold asset when price > SMA, zero weight when price <= SMA. Freed weight from 'out' assets redistributes pro-rata across 'in' assets. Implements Faber (2007) — SMA crossover delivers equity-like returns with materially lower volatility and max drawdown across S&P 500 and 20+ other asset classes. Key difference from repo's TrendFollowingStrategy: binary SMA crossover (no vol-normalization, no continuous momentum) vs. continuous EWMA momentum.
